battle_traits.name: Blighted Regrowth
battle_traits.declare: You can use this ability if there are no friendly Feculent Gnarlmaws on the battlefield.
battle_traits.effect: Set up a Feculent Gnarlmaw on the battlefield wholly within 12" of an objective you control and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives, and other terrain features.

options.name: Infect
options.text:
Pick an enemy unit within 7" of any friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE unit to be the target. You cannot pick a MANIFESTATION or terrain feature.
• If the target is in combat with any friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE units, it has the DISEASED keyword.
• If the target is not in combat with any friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE units, roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has the DISEASED keyword.

options.name: Spread
options.text: Pick a DISEASED enemy unit to be the target. Each other enemy unit within the target's combat range, excluding MANIFESTATIONS and terrain features, has the DISEASED keyword.

options.name: Mutate
options.text: If all enemy units on the battlefield, excluding MANIFESTATIONS and terrain features, have the DISEASED keyword, inflict 1 mortal damage on each of them.

battle_traits.name: Wracked with Disease
battle_traits.declare: Pick each DISEASED enemy unit to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

battle_traits.name: Ceaseless Infectors
battle_traits.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was in combat with a friendly ROTBRINGERS unit that was destroyed this turn to be the target. You cannot pick a MANIFESTATION or terrain feature.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has the DISEASED keyword.

battle_traits.name: Burst Pustules
battle_traits.effect: Each time a DISEASED enemy unit is destroyed, before the last model in the unit is removed from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick another enemy unit within 9" of that model to be the target. You cannot pick a MANIFESTATION or terrain feature. The target has the DISEASED keyword.

battle_traits.name: Desperate Remedies
battle_traits.effect: If an ability would heal or return slain models to a DISEASED enemy unit, that ability does not heal or return any slain models to it. Instead, it no longer has the DISEASED keyword.

abilities.name: Plague Progenitor
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the plague progenitor for the rest of the battle. You cannot pick a MANIFESTATION or terrain feature.
abilities.effect:
Roll 2D3. On a 6, or if the roll equals or exceeds the plague progenitor's Health characteristic, it has the DISEASED keyword.
In the first battle round, if an ability would heal or return any slain models to a DISEASED plague progenitor, that ability does not
heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.
Each time the plague progenitor is picked to be the target of the 'Spread' effect of the 'Blessed by the Plaguefather' ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within its combat range, excluding MANIFESTATIONS and terrain features, in addition to the effect of that ability.

abilities.name: Vectors of Contagion
abilities.effect: Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-HERO ROTBRINGERS units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON units.

abilities.name: Denizens of the Garden
abilities.effect: Companion weapons used by friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE units have Crit (2 Hits).

abilities.name: Filth-laden Daemonic Blooms
abilities.effect: Each time you make a run roll for a friendly non-MONSTER MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON unit, you can change that roll to a 4.

entries.name: Grandfather's Blessing
entries.effect: If this unit is in combat with a DISEASED enemy unit, Heal (D3) this unit.

entries.name: Gift of Febrile Frenzy
entries.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-HERO MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Overpowering Stench
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect:
You and your opponent must roll off. If your roll is higher, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target.

entries.name: Living Plague
entries.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
entries.effect: The target has the DISEASED keyword.

entries.name: Unctuous Preacher
entries.effect: If this unit is not a PRIEST, it has PRIEST (1). If this unit is already a PRIEST, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.

entries.name: Corpulent Avalanche
entries.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
entries.effect:
Roll a number of dice equal to this unit’s Move characteristic. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
If any damage points were allocated to the target by this ability, this unit can move 2D3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.

entries.name: The Witherstave
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: The Carrion Dirge
entries.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
entries.effect: Subtract 5 from the targets' control scores until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Rustfang
entries.declare: Pick an enemy HERO or MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Snuggling Sickness
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Each time the target uses a RETREAT ability, if it is in combat with this unit, roll 2D6 as a reaction and add the target's Control characteristic to the roll. On an 8+, that RETREAT ability has no effect.
• The target cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in reserve.

entries.name: Chuckling Murrain
entries.effect:
Your opponent must spend 1 additional rage dice for a unit to use the 'Eruption of Fury' ability while it is in combat with this unit.

When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with this unit, each time your opponent would spend rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability, they must spend 1 additional rage dice.

In both cases, that additional dice does not count towards the number of rage dice spent for the purposes of the ability.

entries.name: The Weeping Flux
entries.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack, roll a number of dice equal to this unit's Health characteristic. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit.

entries.name: Fleshy Abundance
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Heal (D3) the target.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Crippling Despair
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Cloying Quagmire
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Halve the target's Move characteristic.
• If the target's Save characteristic is 3+ or better, subtract 1 from run rolls and charge rolls for the target.

entries.name: Gift of Disease
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with the chanter. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, each enemy unit in combat with the chanter, excluding MANIFESTATIONS and terrain features, has the DISEASED keyword.

entries.name: Favoured Poxes
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the chanter to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 2 from charge rolls for the target. If the chanting roll was 10+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1, instead.

entries.name: Bloated with Sickness
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-MONSTER MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE unit wholly within 12" of the chanter to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to the target in each phase. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

entries.name: Infectious Surge
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, for the rest of the turn, the target can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.

entries.name: Frothing Mucus
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the Charge (+1 Damage) weapon ability has no effect on combat attacks that target the target. If the chanting roll was 6+, weapon abilities other than the Companion weapon ability have no effect instead.

entries.name: Agonising Vomiting
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Roll 7 dice. If the chanting roll was 6+, add 2 to each roll. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

entries.name: Agonising Vomiting
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Roll 7 dice. If the target is DISEASED, add 1 to each roll. If the chanting roll was 7+, add 1 to each roll. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

entries.name: Febrile Advance
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 3" to the distance each target can move when making pile-in moves.

entries.name: Blunting Blight
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, the targets' attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
